name: Platypus
fix_description: In _slippage, the coverage ratio (cash/liability) uses the current pool cash balance which can be manipulated via flash loans. A large deposit temporarily inflates cash, altering the slippage curve in favor of the attacker. Fix: use time-weighted cash values, or implement flash loan guards that snapshot cash before operations.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a multi-step DeFi exploit using a dual-asset flash loan and several protocol-specific pool actions (deposit, swap, partial withdraw, final unwind) to manipulate Platypus pool cash/liability accounting. It is not a trivial bug pattern and requires understanding the pool’s pricing mechanics, but the PoC itself is still fairly direct and compact once the accounting flaw is known.
